taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-15, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AKHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-15, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-15 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-15 presents a 6-layer geoelectric section extending to resistive basement:
- **Layer 1:** 1132.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, base at 7.42 m
- **Layer 2:** 3621.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, base at 25.09 m
- **Layer 3:** 4447.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, base at 26.79 m
- **Layer 4:** 4307.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, base at 27.32 m
- **Layer 5:** 7664.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, base at 32.24 m
- **Layer 6 (Basement):** 12762.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$

Evaluating consecutive layer triplets gives:
1. Layers 1–3 ($r_1 < r_2 < r_3$): **A**
2. Layers 2–4 ($r_2 < r_3 > r_4$): **K**
3. Layers 3–5 ($r_3 > r_4 < r_5$): **H**
4. Layers 4–6 ($r_4 < r_5 < r_6$): **A**

The calculated sequence confirms the archived **AKHA-type** curve classification accurately represents the resistivity model.

{"curve_type_stated": "AKHA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
